name: search_components
description: Find components by name, summary, or module. Returns each match with its kind, path, one-line summary, and the scenes that render it. Start here.

query.description: Words to match, or empty for everything

kind.description: Optional: builders mount in one expression, views are held in an Entity

name: component
description: The exact public API of one component: constructors, chainable options, commands that need a Context, queries, the events it reports, and its scenes. These signatures are generated from the source, so prefer them over recall.

name.description: Component name, such as Badge or DataGrid

name: scene
description: The source of one canonical scene. This code compiles and renders inside the repository's gate, so it is a verified example rather than a written one.

name.description: Scene name, such as badge or data-grid

name: render_scene
description: The image of a scene, in one theme. Use it to check what something actually looks like instead of assuming. A still frame holds a repeating animation at its first frame, so review motion by running the gallery.

name: rules
description: The conventions this repository enforces through its gate: no literal strings in components, no hard-coded visual values, truthful states, stable semantic ids. Read this before writing a component.
